title: Amaro Helicopters

services.name: Helicopter Rides
services.desc: On this tour you will learn about Fullerton and the history of its airport. You’ll travel over historic Downtown Fullerton where you’ll see local favorite restaurants and bar hang outs. On this tour you’ll also see the entire OC basin. This tour is always a favorite for the kids. No lines where you’re going, come and experience the thrill of flying over Knott's Berry Farm, Soak City and seeing Disneyland from Tinkerbell's point of view. On your way to Huntington Beach (Surf City USA) you will also see Medieval Times, Pirates Adventure, and the entire OC basin. Get a bird’s eye view of the World Famous Queen Mary, also known as the “Grey Ghost” during WWII. This tour is great for all ages.

services.name: Jet Charters

We have many clients who rely on us to provide them with the highest quality of personal air travel service. Be it for business, personal or entertainment purposes, we quite simply have the experience and ability to make sure you get where you need to be, when you need to be there. When you need to get to your destination without the hassle of Southern California traffic, we can get you there in comfort and style. We can fly you directly to or from a number of Southern California airports or helipads. Helicopters are an efficient and perfect way to get you
